result.topic_en: Hilbert ends a remark involving Prof. Gordan, then claims that symbolic calculation in invariant theory relates to his theorems as Jacobi's computations relate to the later Weierstrass/Riemann theory of elliptic functions, and that symbolism has harmed invariant theory; a new note begins on approximating the exponential function by rational functions.

items.english: 1.) Symbolic calculation and [computation] in invariant theory always stand to my theorems in the same relation as Jacobi's computations in the theory of elliptic functions stand to the subsequent theory of Weierstrass or of Riemann.
